description.value: Blue Bear Bed and Breakfast is a guest house situated in Tofino, on Vancouver Island's wild west coast — one of BC's premier cycling destinations. Located on Tonquin Park Road, it sits near Tonquin Beach and the old-growth forest trails that attract visitors to this remote surf town. Touring cyclists finishing or starting the Pacific Coast route would find Tofino a logical base, and a B&B of this type typically offers a more personal stay than a motel.
